title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Are you an experienced Commercial Property Legal Assistant who enjoys getting stuck into the matter work as well as the admin? This St Albans role will give you real variety in a team that will value what you bring.

We are working with a highly regarded commercial law firm that wants to add a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to its busy Commercial Real Estate team. The firm has a professional but friendly culture, flexible working and a supportive team where you can keep learning and progressing.

The role combines legal secretarial support with legal assistant work, so you'll get a real mix of both. The team is very busy, so they need someone with commercial property experience who can hit the ground running and support several fee-earners at once.

The role

As Commercial Property Legal Assistant, your duties will include:
- Preparing HM Land Registry applications (AP1, TR1), dealing with requisitions and tracking progress

- File opening, AML and ID checks (SmartSearch and Legl), and file closures
- Financial admin, including invoices, payment requests and credit control
- Managing diaries and arranging meetings

About you
- Experience in a commercial property team
- A good working knowledge of HM Land Registry processes and SDLT
- Comfortable using Word, Outlook, Excel, DocuSign and PDF software (iManage experience is helpful)
- Able to juggle competing priorities and still meet deadlines
- High attention to detail and a confident phone manner

What's on offer
- £35,000 to £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- 25 days' annual leave
- Workplace pension
- Death in service cover at four times salary
- Extra discretionary perks
- Ongoing training and development
- Based in St Albans - some hybrid working may be available (depending on experience)

If you're a Commercial Property Legal Assistant, or a Commercial Property Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant ready for more hands-on work, I'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Facilities Administrator - 14 Month FTC
description:
Facilities Coordinator - 14 Month FTC
£27,000-£30,000 depending on experience + Annual Bonus & Reviews Hemel Hempstead Monday-Friday Office Based

Are you an organised, customer-focused coordinator with experience in Facilities Management, maintenance scheduling or a similar environment?

We're working with a growing and well-established business that is looking for a Facilities Coordinator to join their team on a 14-month fixed-term contract, supporting a new project focused on working with one of the largest and most recognisable companies in the world.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being at the heart of things - coordinating engineers, speaking with clients, keeping jobs moving and making sure everything is organised and completed properly.

The company places a big emphasis on culture, teamwork and doing things the right way, so they're looking for someone who will fit into that environment just as much as someone with the right experience.

Please note that the offices for this role are based in a part of Hemel Hempstead with no public transport routes, so you must be a driver and have daily access to a vehicle.

What will you be doing?

You'll be responsible for coordinating a busy range of maintenance and facilities activity, acting as the main point of contact between clients, engineers and subcontractors.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating reactive maintenance, planned preventative maintenance (PPM), inspections and other scheduled works.
- Scheduling engineers and subcontractors, arranging access and keeping clients updated throughout the process.
- Speaking with engineers daily to provide job information, answer queries and make sure work is progressing as it should.
- Monitoring outstanding jobs and chasing reports, job sheets, timesheets and other information through to completion.
- Keeping job, scheduling and service information accurate across a number of systems.
- Maintaining trackers and purchase order logs, supporting the accurate monitoring of works, costs and invoicing.
- Supporting the financial administration of contracts, including checking subcontractor invoices and ensuring costs are accurate.
- Maintaining client compliance documentation and supporting wider quality and compliance requirements.
- Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Compliance and Finance to make sure everything runs smoothly.
- Assisting with reports, client reviews, audits and operational updates.
- Visiting client sites regularly to build relationships and keep up to date with what is happening on site.
- Looking for ways to improve processes, systems and the overall customer experience.

Don't worry if you haven't used all of the systems mentioned above - experience with scheduling systems or other facilities management software would be a big advantage, but we're more interested in someone who is organised, capable and picks things up quickly.

What are we looking for?

We're ideally looking for someone with some form of office-based experience. Anything relevant to Facilities Management, maintenance coordination or scheduling would be ideal, but character is of the utmost importance to this company and they can train on a lot of the job.

You'll need to be:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Comfortable working at pace and managing multiple priorities.
- Confident communicating with clients, engineers and subcontractors.
- Naturally proactive - someone who sees something that needs doing and gets on with it.
- Customer-focused and keen to build strong working relationships.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Someone who enjoys being part of a team and contributes positively to the wider culture.

Please note: This is an office-based role, so you'll need to be able to drive and have access to your own vehicle, as there will also be visits to client sites.

What's on offer?
- £27,000-£30,000 salary, depending on experience
- 14-month fixed-term contract
- Discretionary annual bonus
- Full annual performance appraisal
- Monday-Thursday: 8:30am-5:00pm - early finish on Fridays
- Office-based role with regular client site visits
- Opportunity to work closely with a major aviation client
- A genuinely collaborative and culture-focused working environment
- The chance to develop your Facilities Management and coordination experience within an established business

Think Specialist Recruitment

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

title: Bookkeeper - Award Winning Practice, Bishop's Stortford
description:
Bookkeeper - Independent Practice

Bishop's Stortford

TPF Recruitment have partnered with an award winning accountancy practice in Bishop's Stortford to recruit an experienced Bookkeeper into their successful, growing team.

This Bookkeeper position plays a vital role in ensuring the financial accuracy and compliance of a growing independent accounting practice, serving small to medium-sized businesses across diverse industries.

As Bookkeeper, you will be central to maintaining reliable financial records, delivering timely reporting and supporting clients in meeting their statutory obligations under HMRC regulations and UK accounting standards. With a focus on precision, professionalism and client-centric service, you will leverage cloud-based accounting platforms to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented professional with a minimum 2 years' experience who thrives in a dynamic, client-focused environment.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date financial records for multiple clients using cloud-based accounting software (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks, Sage).
- Regularly process and reconcile bank and credit card transactions to ensure financial accuracy and integrity.
- Prepare monthly and quarterly financial statements, including profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and cash flow statements.
- Support clients with VAT returns, PAYE, and other statutory filings in full compliance with HMRC requirements.
- Proactively collect, verify, and organize financial documentation from clients to ensure completeness and accuracy.
- Assist in the preparation of year-end accounts and provide coordinated support during external audits.
- Establish and maintain secure, organized digital and physical filing systems to ensure data compliance and easy retrieval.
- Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial data promptly, escalating complex issues to senior accountants when necessary.
- Communicate clearly and consistently with clients and internal teams regarding financial status, reporting timelines, and compliance deadlines.
- Stay current with changes in UK tax legislation, accounting standards and regulatory updates to ensure ongoing compliance.

Requirements

Bookkeeper
- Must live a commutable distance from Bishop's Stortford
- This role is a full-time, office-based position.
- Minimum 2 years' professional bookkeeping experience within a reputable accounting or financial services environment.
- Strong knowledge of UK accounting standards, HMRC regulations, and statutory compliance (VAT, PAYE, Corporation Tax).
- Proficiency in cloud-based accounting platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage.

Benefits

Bookkeeper
- Competitive salary package of between £28,000 and £38,000 dependent on experience level.
- Study support with expert mentoring from an experienced leadership team.
- Long term career progression opportunity with an award winning accountancy practice.
- Regular team events.
- Client networking events and supporting of local sporting clubs.
- Central Bishop's Stortford location with parking available.
- Company pension.
